company.name: 11x AI
company.shortDescription: 11x builds AI digital workers for GTM teams to accelerate growth.
company.description:
11x builds AI digital workers that help go-to-market teams create, qualify, and convert pipeline across every channel.

Alice, the outbound digital worker, prospects leads, researches accounts, and runs hyper-personalized outreach end-to-end, pulling context from your CRM, deanonymizing website visitors, and surfacing upsell opportunities. Julian, the inbound digital worker, qualifies and routes leads via voice, chat, SMS, email, and WhatsApp 24/7.

Trusted by teams at Xerox, Checkr, Sage, and Rho, 11x replaces fragmented sales tech stacks with one connected GTM engine. Backed by $75M from a16z, Benchmark, and HubSpot, 11x powers hundreds of revenue teams, from high-growth startups to global enterprises.
